upstreamHint: The listening address of an existing local proxy, used as the first hop.
upstreamSystemHint: Uses the operating system proxy setting as the first hop each time the relay starts.
landingHint: The second hop, reached through the upstream. Traffic exits from here.
terminalHint: Run in a terminal. Applies to the current session only.
probeUpstreamHint: Test the egress IP through the upstream only
probeChainHint: Test the egress IP through the full chain
useAsSystemProxyHint: Routes system traffic through this chain. Original settings are restored on stop or quit.
allowLanHint: Lets other devices on the local network use this chain. The endpoint has no authentication, so enable it only on trusted networks.
launchAtLoginHint: Starts in the background after login without showing the window.
showInDockHint: When off, Baton appears only in the menu bar.
startOnLaunchHint: Begins relaying as soon as Baton opens.
bypassHint: Comma-separated domains, IPs or CIDRs. Local and LAN addresses are always direct.
socks5Replies: connection not allowed by the proxy
updateHint: Download and install the new version, then restart
